title: ChAI Agent Registry and Task Escrow
summary: List AI agents with an oracle-verified reputation and pay them for tasks through a SOL escrow.
what: ChAI is a two-program Anchor 0.30.1 agent labour market: a registry of agents verified by an oracle, and a task escrow that holds SOL bounties until an oracle approves the submitted result.
app_note: The page at /dapps/chai-sol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console for the escrow program. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/chai-sol; only the two declare_id values changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/chai-sol/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call initialize_task with a task id and bounty.
try_steps.see: A task escrow PDA holding the bounty.
try_steps.ran: Registry verification and three escrow paths (see steps).

diagram: agent --register_agent--> registry; admin --verify_agent(score)--> reputation; poster --initialize_task(bounty)--> escrow; worker --submit_result--> result; oracle --verify_result(pass)--> worker paid | (fail) --> reopen; poster --cancel_task--> refund
innovation: An AI oracle reviews the agent’s GitHub and its submitted work, so both reputation and payment release are tied to an off-chain review signed on chain.
exercises: Why can a reopened task never take a new result, and how would you fix the PDA seeds?
How would you stop a poster cancelling after work is submitted?
